subject: regional-malayalam
title: Malayalam — Set 2
description: Common phrases, nature words, and question words

questions.question: What does 'പുസ്തകം' (Pusthakam) mean?
questions.explanation: 'പുസ്തകം' means book in Malayalam. It comes from Sanskrit 'pustakam'.

questions.question: What does 'സൂര്യൻ' (Suryan) mean?
questions.explanation: 'സൂര്യൻ' means Sun in Malayalam. Related to Sanskrit 'Surya'.

questions.question: What does 'മഴ' (Mazha) mean?
questions.explanation: 'മഴ' means rain in Malayalam. Kerala is famous for heavy monsoon rains.

questions.question: What does 'കൂട്ടുകാരൻ' (Koottukaaran) mean?
questions.explanation: 'കൂട്ടുകാരൻ' means friend (male) in Malayalam. 'കൂട്ടുകാരി' for female friend.

questions.question: How do you say 'two' in Malayalam?
What does 'മരം' (Maram) mean?
questions.explanation: 'മരം' means tree in Malayalam. 'മരങ്ങൾ' (Marangal) is the plural.

questions.question: What does 'രാത്രി' (Raathri) mean?
questions.explanation: 'രാത്രി' means night in Malayalam. 'രാവിലെ' = morning, 'വൈകുന്നേരം' = evening.

questions.question: What does 'എന്ത്' (Enthu) mean?
questions.explanation: 'എന്ത്' means What in Malayalam. Example: 'നിന്റെ പേര് എന്ത്?' = What is your name?

questions.question: Malayalam is the official language of which Indian state?
questions.explanation: Malayalam is the official language of Kerala. It is also spoken in Lakshadweep and parts of Karnataka.
